item.title: HIGHLIGHTS: Coahoma's season ends after regional final battle with Wall
item.description: BIG SPRING, Texas (KMID/KPEJ) - Coahoma's season has come to an end after falling to Wall in the regional final. The Hawks took over the second half, winning 56-42. The Bulldogettes finish the season with a 34-2 record, going undefeated in the district at 12-0.
